item.title: Ambulante Gira de Documentales 2027: Call for Documentaries
item.description:
Organisation: Ambulante

Location: Touring documentary festival across Mexico (Mexico City, Queretaro, Michoacan, Morelos, Baja California and northwest Mexico)

Award: Selection for the touring programme. Free to submit, no entry fee.

Duration: Festival tour in 2027; work-in-progress selections must be completed by 19 November 2026

Deadline: Closed 03 Aug 2026

Ambulante's open call for its 2027 travelling documentary festival, which tours screenings across Mexico. Documentaries produced in 2025 or 2026 are eligible, and films may be finished or still in development: work-in-progress submissions are accepted provided the film is completed by 19 November 2026 and provisional viewing access is given in the registration form. Previous Mexican release does not disqualify a film, though unpremiered work is prioritised. SECTIONS: Pulsos, for Mexican documentaries over 60 minutes; and Coordenadas, for local productions from the participating regions (Mexico City, Queretaro, Michoacan, Morelos, Baja California and northwest Mexico) in feature, medium and short formats. Selected filmmakers must supply ProRes 422HQ or 4444 files at 1920x1080 or better, WAV audio, and SRT subtitles (Spanish subtitles are required for non-Spanish-language films; English subtitles are optional for Spanish-language films), plus director contact details and a press kit; DCP is optional for Pulsos. Submit through the online Airtable form; finished films need viewing links with passwords active through November 2026. Entry is completely free. Closes Monday 3 August 2026.

item.title: 41st Mar del Plata International Film Festival: Call for Entries
item.description:
Organisation: Festival Internacional de Cine de Mar del Plata / INCAA

Location: Mar del Plata, Argentina (festival 5-15 November 2026). Open to international entries; no prior public screening in Argentina.

Award: Selection in Latin America's only FIAPF A-accredited competitive festival (International and Latin American competitions, In Transit/WIP, Panorama). No submission fee stated on the registration page.

Duration: Festival 5-15 November 2026. Films completed November 2025 to November 2026.

Deadline: Closed 15 Jul 2026

The Mar del Plata International Film Festival is the only FIAPF A-list competitive festival in Latin America. The 41st edition accepts international entries across all genres for its International and Latin American competitions, the In Transit work-in-progress section, and Panorama. Films must be completed between November 2025 and November 2026 and not previously publicly screened in Argentina. Extended deadline 15 July 2026; submissions via the INCAA portal.
